name: Mødelokale Booking
description: See, book and cancel the office meeting rooms at booking.birdsatfive.dk: a room plan in a tab, and bookingctl for the vault's agent.

check.hint: Sign in to the booking site: open Rooms.local.booking, or ask the agent to run bookingctl login

verbs.status: Signed in to the booking site? As whom
verbs.finish: Sign in with the link from that email: finish '<link>'
verbs.availability: Every room's busy times on a day, today unless given: availability [YYYY-MM-DD]
verbs.cancel: Cancel your booking: cancel <room> --at 13:00 [--on fri], or cancel <booking id>
verbs.plan: Create Rooms.local.booking, the room plan, in the vault
